name: Legally Bi
source:
Sensu, as a transfer student from mainland China, has a secret that nobody knows...That he is actually, a she.

After accidentally skipping class because of her bully, Sensu met Ai Xin, another problematic student in her school, and quickly they became skipping school buddies----But only a day later, Ai Xin was found dead and appeared in front of Sensu as a ghost.

This is a story where a normal high schooler is stuck between genders, politics, and the afterlife.

[From [url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/legallybi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
森苏，作为来自中国大陆的转校生，有着一个无人知晓的秘密……他其实是，一个她。

因被欺负而意外逃课后，森苏遇到了学校里的另一个问题学生艾欣，很快他们就成为了逃学伙伴----但仅仅一天后，艾欣被发现死亡，并以鬼魂的形式出现在森苏面前。

这是一个普通高中生陷入性别、政治和来世之间的故事。

[来自[url=https://daruku-darc.itch.io/legallybi]itch.io[/url]]
